description: This file defines classes, interfaces, and functions related to updating and managing the F-Droid index repositories, including versioning, update results, URI building, and download progress handling.

classes.name: IndexFormatVersion
classes.description: Enum representing supported index format versions (ONE, TWO).

classes.name: IndexUpdateResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing possible outcomes of an index update (Unchanged, Processed, NotFound, Error).

classes.name: IndexUpdateListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving download and update progress callbacks.

classes.name: RepoUriBuilder
classes.description: Functional interface for building URIs for repository downloads.

classes.name: TempFileProvider
classes.description: Functional interface for creating temporary files, possibly throwing IOException.

classes.name: IndexUpdater
classes.description: Abstract class for updating repository index information, handling versioning and errors.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a repository and resets error count if unchanged.

methods.name: updateRepo
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the actual repository update.

methods.name: catchExceptions
methods.description: Handles exceptions during update, returning appropriate IndexUpdateResult.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Logs errors related to repository update failures.
